User goal: 'identify the largest renewable generation contribution source, then route that source record to priority contribution follow-up.'
Option labels: 'Route Solar for priority contribution follow-up', 'Route Wind for priority contribution follow-up', 'Keep Hydroelectric on routine contribution monitoring'.
uncertain: The printed percentage labels (41.2%, 29.8%, 18.5%, 7.2%, 3.3%) do not match the bar heights on the 0-70 y-axis (e.g., Wind's bar reaches ~68 but is labeled 29.8%; Solar's bar reaches 40 but is labeled 41.2%). It is unclear whether the y-axis represents a different quantity than the percentage labels, or whether one channel is mis-scaled.
No unit or axis title is printed on the y-axis, so the meaning of the 0-70 scale (e.g., TWh, GWh, index) is not stated.
The relationship between the bar-height values and the percentage data labels is not explained on the chart, leaving ambiguity about which channel defines 'largest contribution'.
